_note: ADR-047 Phase 3 (consume-or-dsar): the app-side AVG/DSAR workflow (AvgRequests dashboard / AvgIntake / AvgRequestDetail pages + their views) was removed. OpenRegister owns the data-subject-request case engine and serves its own AVG UI at /apps/openregister/avg. Pipelinq exposes a single deep-link nav entry that opens that surface (href, new tab) — the same pattern the MDM steward views used — and registers pipelinq CRM objects as an evidence source (PipelinqEvidenceSourceProvider) so DSAR fulfilment harvests them. Existing avgVerzoek objects are migrated to OR dataSubjectRequest cases by the MigrateAvgVerzoekenToOrDsar repair step.
